review_scope: Local CPU-only source-based review of the 31 TRAIN candidate complete chosen responses; this task made no network or GPU calls. The full round used 62 successful DeepSeek calls.
status: Data prepared; not scheduled, trained, or evaluated
limitations: Independent local agent plus same external teacher family is not clinical expert adjudication.
The semantic contrast is source-grounded; original positive silver targets remain unchanged and are not exhaustive medical gold.
Core means characteristic in this dataset; it does not assert every symptom is universally present.
Some supported causal relations depend on the complete induced/withdrawal definition, not temporal language alone.
The three hierarchy inversions rely on explicit named subclass restrictions or an includes heading.
Seven full sequences remain quarantined; no hold is automatically a corrected negative label.
Many candidate sources were already used by SFT; this is training-data review, not heldout proof of generalization.
